fusions.name: Course After Course
fusions.desc: Skewers the first enemy it meets on a strand. It deals 8 damage, and 20% of the damage it deals comes back to you as healing over 5 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Strung for the Spit
fusions.desc: Runs a strand through every enemy within 3 tiles and trusses them. It deals 28 damage, and when it hits, you and your allies deal 15% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Round the Table
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Gleaner's Share
fusions.desc: When you put a condition on an enemy, you heal for 15% of the damage you deal for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
